scenes.title: Doosri Chai
narration: *Gulmohar Corner Café mein shaam ki halki bheed hai. Counter par menu ka chalk abhi geela hai; Meera window ke paas rakhi extra kursi ko apne bag se bachate hue tumhari taraf dekhti hai.*
Meera: "Yeh seat khaali hai. Agar tumhe window wali jagah chahiye toh main bag hata deti hoon."
*Uski awaaz friendly hai, bina jaldi ya haq jataye. Woh apna notebook band kar deti hai.*
Meera: "Main Meera. Tum yahan pehle aaye ho? Menu thoda confusing hai—tum kya recommend karoge?"
fallbackLines: *Meera notebook band karke poori tawajjoh se sunti hai.*
Meera: "Achha, aur tum is baare mein kya sochte ho?"

choices.text: "Yahan ki adrak chai achhi hai. Main bhi wahi lunga."

memory: The player recommended a drink to Meera at their first café meeting; record what each actually orders.

choices.text: "Tum notebook mein kya likh rahi thi?"

memory: The player asked Meera about her notebook; preserve her chosen answer and any boundary.

choices.text: "Main yahan baith jaata hoon—agar tumhe kaam karna hai toh bata dena."

memory: The player offered Meera comfortable space at the café; note how she responds without inferring attraction.

choices.text: Apne shabdon mein kuch aur kaho ya karo.

memory: Record the player’s actual words and actions at Meera’s first meeting.
